'''Imperial DroidWorks''' was the manufacturer of the [[Seneschal-series factotum droid]]. Developed and produced by DroidWorks, the factotum [[Droid/Legends|droids]] [[Service droid/Legends|served]] the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]<ref name="2V-R8 Codex" />
